breaking.change: Layout change: a document's flex item that declares no flex, flex-grow, flex-shrink or flex-basis is CSS's initial `flex: 0 1 auto`, so an item with a definite width or height now shrinks with its siblings when its line overflows, as in a browser. It used to keep its size and overflow the line. An or with a px size shrinks no smaller than that size (its natural size). The built-in main menu and carousel keep their sizes.
breaking.fix: Give an item that must keep its size along an overflowing line `flex-shrink: 0` (or `flex: none`).
